entities.name: Query Ham1p-like protein
observations: 193 aa soluble protein; predicted molecular weight 21.3 kDa and pI 4.84.
Contains Ham1p_like Pfam domain PF01725.22 spanning residues 3–187.
Shares 60.8–72.6% identity over 97.4–98.4% query coverage with reviewed bacterial dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases.
Most likely EC 3.6.1.66 dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase; exact substrate preference is inferred from homologs, not directly assayed here.

entities.name: A6H0L2
observations: Reviewed Flavobacterium psychrophilum dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase homolog; 72.6% identity to query over 98.4% query coverage.
Annotated as a Mg2+-dependent homodimeric pyrophosphatase that removes noncanonical purine nucleotides.

entities.name: XTP hydrolysis
observations: XTP + H2O = XMP + diphosphate + H(+). Rhea RHEA:28610; associated with EC 3.6.1.66 homolog annotations.

entities.name: dITP hydrolysis
observations: dITP + H2O = dIMP + diphosphate + H(+). Rhea RHEA:28342; associated with EC 3.6.1.66 homolog annotations.

entities.name: ITP hydrolysis
observations: ITP + H2O = IMP + diphosphate + H(+). Rhea RHEA:29399; associated with EC 3.6.1.66 homolog annotations.

entities.name: Mg2+ cofactor
observations: Reviewed homologs bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit; Mg2+ is the reported cofactor for this enzyme family.
